summary: St. Gallen has charged for about 600 centre surface spaces every day since 1 January 2022, and from 1 November 2024 raised the centre white-zone day rate to CHF 2.50 per hour and introduced night permits in the Extended Blue Zone, after the Swiss Price Supervisor had recommended on 20 March 2024 cutting fees and dropping increases. Fees are now the main political issue: the Stadtparlament rejected the Parkgebühr-Initiative 38 to 20 on 25 August 2026 and a popular vote is scheduled for 28 February 2027, while a second initiative asks for above-ground parking at about 2015 levels (a proposal). Garages are run by a mix of operators (City Parking St. Gallen AG, Indigo Suisse at Neumarkt from 1 April 2025 and listing Parkhaus Central, which opened in March 2025 and is in a tariff dispute with the city), with the Kreuzbleiche garage planned to be renovated from June 2026 to May 2027.

items.text: The city announced on 25 November 2021 that from 1 January 2022 about 600 public surface parking spaces in the city centre (plus Spelteriniplatz) become fee-paying every day, around the clock, instead of only Monday to Friday 8am-7pm and Saturday 8am-5pm. The rate is CHF 2.00 per hour by day (7am-midnight) and CHF 1.50 per hour at night (midnight-7am) and on Sundays. The city said the aim was to use spaces more appropriately and make underground garages more attractive.

The Swiss Price Supervisor, consulted on the city's planned parking-regulation changes, recommended on 20 March 2024 that Extended Blue Zone (EBZ) parking fees be cut by 37% and White Zone fees by 59%, and that planned fee increases be dropped. In the same letter, figures supplied by the city showed that only 455 of 2,800 car-park spaces in garages (16.25%) are publicly managed, so the supervisor treated garage prices as outside his remit.

The city announced fee changes effective 1 November 2024: the daytime rate on white-zone surface parking in the centre rises from CHF 2.00 to CHF 2.50 per hour (night and Sunday stay at CHF 1.50), and outside the centre a night (midnight-7am) and Sunday rate of CHF 1.00 per hour is introduced.
items.source_title: Die Stadt St.Gallen passt Parkiergebühren an

items.text: As listed on the city's page in October 2026, the Extended Blue Zone requires a permit 8am-7pm and 7pm-8am; resident permits cost CHF 30/month (day) or CHF 40/month (day and night), commuter permits CHF 150/month (day) or CHF 160/month (day and night), night parking CHF 30/month and a 24-hour day pass CHF 10.

A parking initiative submitted by a committee behind the association Stadtstrasse reached 1,013 valid signatures (1,000 required), per the city chancellery. It asks for a 'moderate number' of above-ground parking spaces in the centre and old town 'at the level of around 2015', short-term customer parking, parking for public pools and sports facilities, and protected bike storage in residential buildings, to be set in a parking regulation. The same association had earlier submitted a separate parking-fee initiative that was declared valid on 28 January.
items.source_title: Parkplatz-Initiative ist in der Stadt St. Gallen zustande gekommen

items.text: On 25 August 2026 the Stadtparlament rejected the 'Parkgebühr-Initiative' by 38 to 20 votes with 1 abstention. It also debated counter-proposals: the FDP proposed abolishing fees on Sundays and at midday (12:00-13:30) plus lower EBZ rates, and the GLP proposed abolishing night parking fees in the EBZ; putting the initiative with the GLP counter-proposal to voters was rejected 31 to 28 (1 abstention).
The Stadtrat set 28 February 2027 as the date of the popular vote on the Parkgebühr-Initiative, which the Stadtparlament rejected on 25 August 2026 without a counter-proposal.

A blue News report (page metadata: published 13 May 2026, based on Tagblatt reporting) describes a 'wild patchwork' of garage tariffs in St. Gallen, citing CHF 2 per hour at Brühltor and Burggraben, CHF 2.60 at the station garage, CHF 2.40 at the town hall and a half-hour system at Neumarkt, and notes that a political initiative proposes cutting fees by about 40-60% and free parking on Sundays and at night (7pm-7am).
items.source_title: Parking tariff dispute in St. Gallen: City considers legal action against parking garage

items.text: Parkhaus Central (Unterer Graben 25) is operated by Indigo Suisse and listed with 614 spaces over 9 levels, open 24/7, 4 EV charging stations and 14 disabled spaces. Short-term tariffs listed: CHF 2.00 first hour, CHF 3.40 up to 2 hours, CHF 20.00 for 24 hours.
Indigo Suisse announced on 12 March 2025 that from 1 April 2025 it would operate the historic Neumarkt car park in St. Gallen, with a 24/7 remote management centre.
items.source_title: Betrieb des NEUMARKT Parkhauses in St. Gallen

items.text: Parkhaus Neumarkt is listed by the Parkleitsystem with 274 publicly managed spaces, 10 EV charging stations (11 kW), operator INDIGO Suisse AG, open Monday-Saturday 05:00-00:40 and closed Sundays and holidays; tariff CHF 1.50 per 30 minutes in the first hour, then CHF 2.00 per 40 minutes, maximum CHF 25 per day.
items.source_title: Parkhaus Neumarkt – Öffnungszeiten, Preise, freie Parkplätze | Parkleitsystem St. Gallen

items.text: The Parkleitsystem St. Gallen (run by PLS Parkleitsystem St. Gallen AG, a company owned by private garage operators and the city) lists 13 facilities with free-space displays: Neumarkt, Rathaus, Manor, Cityparking Bahnhof, Kreuzbleiche, Oberer Graben, Raiffeisenzentrum, Einstein, Burggraben, Spisertor, Brühltor, Stadtpark/AZSG and Spelteriniplatz.
items.source_title: Freie Parkplätze in St. Gallen – Parkleitsystem PLS

items.text: Cityparking Bahnhof is operated by City Parking St. Gallen AG (Oberer Graben 14), open 24 hours; the Parkleitsystem lists a standard rate of CHF 2.60 per hour (6am-10pm) and CHF 1.20 at night, 4 EV charging stations on level 4 underground, and day passes of CHF 25 (24h), CHF 50 (48h) and CHF 75 (72h).
items.source_title: Cityparking Bahnhof – Öffnungszeiten, Preise, freie Parkplätze | Parkleitsystem St. Gallen

items.text: Cityparking Brühltor is operated by City Parking St. Gallen AG and listed as open 24 hours with 9 EV charging stations on level 2 underground; the Parkleitsystem lists CHF 2.00 for the first hour then CHF 1.00 per 30 minutes (Sunday-Friday 7am-midnight), CHF 1.20 at night, and CHF 2.40 on Saturdays and during events.
items.source_title: Cityparking Brühltor – Öffnungszeiten, Preise, freie Parkplätze | Parkleitsystem St. Gallen

items.text: Parkhaus Einstein (Wassergasse 7, near the cathedral) is listed with 126 publicly managed spaces, operator Wildegg Immobilien AG, a tariff of CHF 2.50 per hour around the clock, and night access via the hotel reception between midnight and 6am.
items.source_title: Parkhaus Einstein – Öffnungszeiten, Preise, freie Parkplätze | Parkleitsystem St. Gallen

items.text: The city page for Parkgarage Kreuzbleiche (publicly run; tariff CHF 1.50 per hour by day, CHF 1.00 at night) states that the garage is being renovated between June 2026 and May 2027 with limited parking availability.
